Definition
[Compact subset $Y(\ell )$ of smooth points avoiding all singular regions] ↗ def:disappearing-region-J ↗ prop:long-L-length-near-surgery-cap

Fix $\ell <\infty $. At each surgery time $\bar t\in [T_{i-1},T]$, remove the evolving cap neighborhoods of radius $(A_0+10)h(\bar t)$ through their maximal standard-flow time and remove $\widetilde J(\bar t-\tau _1(\ell ,\bar t),\bar t)$, where $\tau _1(\ell ,\bar t)=\min (h(\bar t)^2/\ell ,\bar t-\bar t')$ and $\bar t'$ is the preceding surgery time or $0$. Let $Y(\ell )$ be the complement of the union of these open singular neighborhoods in ${\bf t}^{-1}([T_{i-1},T])$. Then $Y(\ell )$ is compact and lies in the smooth locus.

[Existence, semicontinuity, and compactness of limits of short $\mathcal L$-length paths]
